claim: There was good agreement in the fitness values for synonymous variants.

claim: The effect of AAV2 rep variants on production is largely consistent across capsid serotypes.

source: Wild-type AAV has both a lytic and a latent cycle (Liu, 2014).

source: The latent cycle occurs when no helper virus is present.

source: Rep and VP expression are repressed and the AAV genome is integrated into the host cell genome in a process that also involves Rep (Pereira et al., 1997; Surosky et al., 1997).
